items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: It’s an album that Tito Puente did with Mongo Santamaria, Patato and some other percussionists and a bass player.

ctx.x: It’s an album that Tito Puente did with Mongo Santamaria, Patato and some other percussionists and a bass player. [Scats] Then they would solo around that. So that’s a possibility. I haven’t thought about it. You just gave me the idea.
